owner_decision: 19/11: the owner agreed to D18 (attack breadth with behaviour simulators)
registered_before: any change of the campaign for D18 and any run with it

tool.name: falcosecurity/event-generator
tool.note: a behaviour simulator of the Falco project, not an exploit; no vulnerable image, no CVE content

selection_rule: the source of every action at v0.13.0 was read: kept only actions that read sensitive files (open only), act inside their own temp directory or /dev/shm, link or copy inside a temp directory and remove it, run a short child (ptrace TRACEME on sleep, memfd re-exec of itself doing nothing, a copy of ls under /bin removed at once); left out: every action that needs the network, a privileged container, the host, a container escape (release_agent, mount, debugfs), kubectl, a package manager, or that writes outside a temp path it removes
campaign: one more step per trial, label attack_eventgen, through the same kubectl exec path: the binary is staged (sha256 pinned) beside the fixture and removed after the trial; action = actions[trial index % 14]; command: event-generator run ^syscall.<Action>$ --all --sleep 0s; an action skipped for a missing tool (ln, find, shred, sh) is recorded and left out of the rates
reported: detection of the event-generator step by the model alone, per action and all, primary and all rates; it does not change any registered hypothesis of the final run
